notes.title: 🛠️ PATCH NOTES — Now with 100% more Achievements! 🏆
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just rolled out a small but exciting update: Old Timer Transport now has Steam Achievements! 🎉
That’s right, 12 glorious ways to prove you’re the grumpiest, scooteriest menace in Bompidorm!

Whether you're flipping through the air, delivering poor souls to safety, or just being a general menace to society; we're tracking it now. 👀

Go forth and achieve things.
Or just cause chaos. Either works.

🛵💨💥

The Old Timer Team

notes.title: 🚨 Old Timer Transport is officially out NOW! 🛵
notes.notes:
Old Timer Transport is our multiplayer love letter to absurdity, unpredictability, and shared laughter.

💥Explosions.
👴Grumpy drivers.
🏥Emergency hospital drop-offs.
🤪Pure unpredictable multiplayer mayhem.

The best part? It’s 100% free to play!

Thanks to everyone who supported us through development – you’re the real MVPs.❤️

notes.title: 🚀 We Made it to the News! 🚀
notes.notes:
What an exciting time! Last weekend, we were thrilled to have our game featured at Play Day, part of the UNWRAP event. The local gaming community got to experience all the chaos and fun firsthand, and it was an absolute blast watching everyone zip around on their scooters and race to pick up humans! 🛴👀

But that's not all... we also made it to the local Belgian news! 🎥 That's right, our game got its 15 seconds of fame, and we couldn’t be prouder! 🙌 ([url=https://focus-wtv.be/nieuws/play-day-van-unwrapfestival-brengt-bezoekers-en-belgische-gameontwikkelaars-samen]Click Here[/url] To Watch)

A huge thanks to everyone who came out to play, and for the incredible support we've received. We're gearing up for more fun and can’t wait to share even more with you soon.

Stay tuned for updates, and don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142140/?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=steam

Pierre is ready to take flight and maybe... accidentally commit some vehicular manslaughter (without the lawsuits, we hope!). 🚀
See you in the game—or in court! 😅
